QuestInfo.name: Astilda's Request
QuestInfo.1: #p1033102# wants to provide music to soothe the elves in their cursed sleep. #bActivate the Music Box in front of the library#k as #p1033102# requested.
QuestInfo.2: At #p1033102#'s request, you used the Music Box outside of the library. May its music soothe your subjects as they dream...
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Find #b#p1033102#, the Elder of Life#k, first.

0.0: We don't fear the Black Mage's curse. He is sealed away, and in time, the curse will fade. When that happens, we will be waiting for you.
0.1: But I worry for the children, Your Highness. They are too young for such hardship, and won't understand what is happening. Perhaps you could #bprovide them with soothing music#k to comfort them as they sleep?

yes.0: The children are gathered in front of the library. Please\r\n#bactivate the Orgel#k in front of the library for them,\r\nYour Highness...

no.0: They probably won't hear it through the ice, but it's worth a try.

1.0: I pray the music sets their minds at ease.
1.1: Your Majesty... I will see you...when I wake...

quest.0: Please, activate the Music Box... I don't know how much longer...I can hold on...Your Majesty...
